pipeline_page_entries.description_as_stated: LY3209590 "Insulin Efsitora Alfa" is a biologic entity comprised of an engineered insulin fused to an Fc domain designed to provide a long-acting basal profile. LY3209590 is being studied for the treatment of diabetes.
LY3502970 (Orforglipron) is a chemical entity that acts as an agonist for the glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor. It is being studied for the treatment of type 2 diabetes.

LY3298176 (GIP/GLP-1 Receptor Agonist) is a biologic entity that acts as an agonist of both the glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) receptor and the glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor and is being studied for the reduction of adverse cardiovascular outcomes in patients with type 2 diabetes.

LY3009104 (baricitinib) is a small molecule selective JAK1/JAK2 inhibitor that modulates cytokine signaling involved in immune activation and inflammation. It is being studied in two Phase 3 trials for disease modification in type 1 diabetes, investigating both delay of clinical onset in high-risk individuals and preservation of beta-cell function in those with new-onset disease.

LY3537031 (Brenipatide) is a biologic entity that acts as an agonist of both glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) receptor and the glucagon-like peptide (GLP-1) receptor and is being studied for the treatment of alcohol use disorder.

LY3537031 (Brenipatide) is a biologic entity that acts as an agonist of both glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) receptor and the glucagon-like peptide (GLP-1) receptor and is being studied for the treatment of major depressive disorder.
LY3841136 (eloralintide) is a biologic entity that acts as a selective amylin receptor agonist. It is being studied for the treatment of obesity.

LY3841136 (eloralintide) is a biologic entity that acts as a selective amylin receptor agonist. It is being studied for the treatment of patients with overweight or obesity and Obstructive Sleep Apnea.

LY3841136 (eloralintide) is a biologic entity that acts as a selective amylin receptor agonist. It is being studied for the treatment of patients with overweight or obesity and knee osteoarthritis pain.

Investigation of the addition of LY3841136 “eloralintide” (a selective amylin receptor agonist) to weekly injectable incretin for patients with persistent obesity or overweight on stable incretin background therapy.

LY3819469 (Lepodisiran) is a GalNAc-conjugated small interfering RNA (siRNA) that inhibits the production of apolipoprotein(a) (Apo[a]), thereby reducing levels of lipoprotein(a) (Lp[a]). LY3819469 is being studied for the treatment of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD).
LY3473329 (Muvalaplin) is a chemical entity that disrupts lipoprotein(a) (Lp[a]) formation. LY3473329 is being studied for the treatment of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD).

LY3502970 (Orforglipron) is a chemical entity that acts as an agonist for the glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor. It is being studied for the reduction of adverse cardiovascular outcomes in people with established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease and/or chronic kidney disease.

LY3502970 (Orforglipron) is a chemical entity that acts as an agonist for the glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor. It is being studied for the treatment of hypertension in people with obesity or overweight.

LY3502970 (Orforglipron) is a chemical entity that acts as an agonist for the glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor. It is being studied for the treatment of Obstructive Sleep Apnea in people with obesity or overweight.

LY3502970 (Orforglipron) is a chemical entity that acts as an agonist for the glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor. It is being studied for the treatment of knee osteoarthritis pain in people with obesity or overweight.
LY3502970 (Orforglipron) is a chemical entity that acts as an agonist for the glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor. It is being studied for the treatment of Peripheral Artery Disease (PAD).

LY3502970 (Orforglipron) is a chemical entity that acts as an agonist for the glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor. It is being studied for the treatment of Stress Urinary Incontinence (SUI) in females with obesity or overweight.

LY3437943 (GIP/GLP-1/Glucagon Receptor Agonist) is a biologic entity that acts as a triagonist for the gastric inhibitory polypeptide (GIP) receptor, the glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor and the glucagon receptor. It is being studied for the treatment of patients with obesity or overweight and Chronic Low Back Pain.

LY3437943 (GIP/GLP-1/Glucagon Receptor Agonist) is a biologic entity that acts as a triagonist for the gastric inhibitory polypeptide (GIP) receptor, the glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor and the glucagon receptor. LY3537021 (GIPR Agonist Long Acting) is a biologic entity that acts as a long-acting agonist of the glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) receptor. It is being studied for the prevention of Chemotherapy Induced Nausea and Vomiting (CINV).
LY3938577 (Glucose sensing insulin receptor agonist) is a biologic entity being studied for the treatment of diabetes.
LY3532226 (Macupatide) is a biologic entity that acts as a long-acting agonist of the glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) receptor. It is being studied for the treatment of obesity.
LY3549492 (Naperiglipron) is a chemical entity that acts as an agonist for the glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor. It is being studied for the treatment of obesity.
LY3457263 (Nisotirostide) is a biologic entity that acts as a selective NPY2 receptor agonist. It is being studied for the treatment of type 2 diabetes.
LY5625573 "NLRP3 Inhibitor (VTX3232)" is a chemical entity NLRP3 inflammasome inhibitor being studied for the treatment of inflammatory disorders.
LY5625574 “NLRP3 Inhibitor II (VTX2735)” is a chemical entity NLRP3 inflammasome inhibitor being studied for the treatment of recurrent pericarditis.

conflicts: Eloralintide Phase 2 (NCT06230523), percent weight change at 48 weeks: Lilly release 2025-11-06 reports -9.5% (1 mg) and -16.4% (3/6/9 mg; -17.8 kg); ClinicalTrials.gov posted results report LS means of -9.4 (1 mg) and -16.5 (3/6/9 mg; -18.0 kg); the Lancet abstract gives whole-number point estimates (-9%, -16%). Other arms agree (3 mg -12.4, 6 mg -17.6, 9 mg -20.1, 6/9 mg -19.9, placebo -0.4). Likely different analyses/rounding; the registry names no estimand.
Eloralintide Phase 2 arm labels: Lancet abstract uses '6-9 mg' and '3-9 mg'; Lilly release and registry use '6/9 mg' and '3/6/9 mg' for the same dose-escalation arms.
Eloralintide Phase 2 phase label: Lilly's 2025 release, the Lancet title and the registry say 'Phase 2'; Lilly's 2026-09-30 release refers to the same trial as 'a Phase 2b study (NCT06230523)'.

EloraTZP study phase label: Lilly's 2026-09-30 release says 'Phase 2b'; the ClinicalTrials.gov official title for NCT06603571 says 'Phase 2' and Lilly's 2025-11-06 and 2026-09-15 releases call it a 'Phase 2 study'.

EloraTZP arms: Lilly release states a ten-term randomisation ratio and the registry lists ten arm groups (five combination arm groups), but the Lilly results table shows nine arms (four combinations) and the EASD release says 'all four dosing combinations' met the endpoints.

EloraTZP eloralintide-alone dose response is not monotonic in the release (6 mg -12.3%, 9 mg -11.1%); the headline 'up to ... 12.3%' for eloralintide alone therefore refers to the 6 mg arm, not the highest dose. Not a conflict between sources, but easy to mis-attribute.

BELIEVE (NCT05616013) estimand labelling: the Nature Medicine article labels -3.3/-9.3/-14.2/-17.8 kg as 'treatment regimen estimand' results (ANCOVA with placebo-based multiple imputation), while the registry posts the same values (-3.31/-9.25/-14.24/-17.79) under a description of an MMRM with no imputation (analysis method field: ANCOVA) and names no estimand.

BELIEVE DXA values: registry-posted percent changes (e.g., fat mass -42.06% and lean mass -2.51% for bimagrumab 30 mg/kg + semaglutide 2.4 mg; semaglutide 2.4 mg fat mass -24.57%; placebo fat mass -5.53%, lean -0.54%) are close to but not identical with the article's efficacy-estimand figures (combination fat mass up to -42.2%, lean -1.1% to -2.6%; semaglutide up to -24.8%; placebo -5.2% and -0.5%).
Eloralintide Phase 2 publication date: PubMed PubDate (print issue) is 2025 Dec 06 (Lancet 406(10520)); electronic publication and Lilly release date is 2025-11-06.
Eloralintide Phase 2 baseline age dispersion: Lancet abstract labels it 'SE 12.6'; ClinicalTrials.gov baseline module labels the comparable figure (12.65) as standard deviation.
